profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Microsoft
profile.summary:
As a Software Developer at Epic with over one year of experience, I design full-stack solutions that address real user needs in healthcare. Working directly with care managers and clinical staff, I translate their workflows into intuitive tools using C#, TypeScript, and SQL—enabling faster decisions and better patient care.

I prioritize understanding how users work, then build data visualizations and applications that fit their daily routines. Through collaboration and user feedback, I create solutions that solve actual problems, not just add features.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed full-stack data visualization tools using C#, TypeScript, SQL, and M to track healthcare systems' utilization of community resources, enabling data-driven decision-making for patient care. Built web-based task management applications that streamlined care managers' workflows, improving their 
ability to track and prioritize patient care activities. Designed and implemented database solutions using SQL and a proprietary M language to support healthcare analytics platforms, ensuring efficient data retrieval and processing.

positions.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
Provided solutions to diverse technical issues within individual software instances for several healthcare 
systems, ensuring timely resolution and customer satisfaction. Acted as the primary technical liaison for healthcare systems working with customers’ C-suite, hospital IT teams, and internal engineering, communicating development goals, system changes, and software updates. Gathered feedback from customers on development changes, iterating on UI/UX improvements based on real world experiences and technical feasibility.

positions.title: GPG Excel Electrical Hardware Intern
positions.description: I worked with the EM Motor Design Team on a project to determine the viability of the Synchronous Reluctance motor in traction applications. I performed technical research, motor benchmarking, and motor design and simulation.

positions.title: Calculus Tutor
positions.description: I helped Navy ROTC students with any questions about lectures, homework, or exams. I worked with students primarily on Calculus, but also on ECE related work.

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description: I worked as a lab assistant helping with a variety of tasks including construction of cameras, soldering components onto boards, and programming and debugging boards. While working, I also learned about image processing through the testing of the cameras.

positions.title: Summer Intern with the TARGET Program
positions.locationName: Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory in Batavia, IL
positions.description: The TARGET Program is a 6 week internship for high school sophomores and juniors that are interested in STEM related fields. The program combined work and hands-on experiential learning. I personally worked on the Muon G-2 experiment in the mornings then got experience in python programming and CAD from hands-on classes in the afternoons. Attached is the PowerPoint that corresponds with the presentation I gave to explain my time working at the lab.

projects.title: Project Vector
projects.description: A site aimed at using data-driven metrics to track customer success and staff progress with company solutions. The site is built with Node leveraging ReactJS and NextJS for frontend rendering and routing and deployed to Azure. The site is informed by a locally hosted SQL Server backend whose data is maintained through an ETL created with Dagster

projects.title: FM Synthesizer
projects.description: An Android app built in C++ using digital signal processing to perform frequency modulation synthesis. The app featured user-controlled sound envelopes and profile settings as well as a touch-screen virtual keyboard to use the designed sound profile.
